## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Filing-index table (core)
      Objective: Ingest one real closed quarter's quarterly index and the daily indexes that follow it into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing — the package scaffolds only
      Produces: a filing-index table built from real SEC index files; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: O1 — the table holds that quarter's rows and the daily rows after it, and can be queried by CIK, form type and filing date. The findings file records elapsed time, SEC request count, bytes downloaded and row count of the real run.
      Leaves out: manifests (Stage 4); full validation suite (Stage 5); point-in-time awareness (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

      Objective: Download the submissions that Stage 1's table rows name.
      Outcomes: O2

      Produces: submissions on disk, each traceable to its index row
      Exit: O2 — every submission named by Stage 1's rows is on disk, or is listed as failed with its reason. The run's elapsed time, request count, file count and bytes are recorded.
      Leaves out: manifests (Stage 4); full validation suite (Stage 5); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick the 10-K and 8-K filings out of Stage 2's submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's downloaded submissions
      Produces: extracted main documents for 10-K and 8-K filings
      Exit: O3 — each 10-K and 8-K in Stage 2's submissions has its main document extracted, or is listed as failed with its reason, with counts per form type. The run's elapsed time is recorded.
      Leaves out: manifests (Stage 4); full validation suite (Stage 5); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

      Objective: Record each source's origin, content hash and processing state, so that interrupted runs resume and reprocessing reads stored bytes.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–3
      Produces: manifests covering index files, submissions and extractions
      Exit: O1/O2 — an interrupted download resumes without re-fetching completed files. O3 — re-extraction from stored submissions issues zero SEC requests.
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Stage 5); point-in-time awareness (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

      Objective: Cover the historical index and submission formats in the backfill range with committed fixtures, and make malformed input fail closed.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 4's manifests
      Produces: a full validation suite run in CI
      Exit: O1 — fixtures for each index format in the confirmed historical range pass. O2 — truncated or HTML-error downloads are rejected. O3 — fixtures for each 10-K and 8-K document layout pass, and unsupported layouts fail closed.
      Leaves out: point-in-time awareness (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Full-history backfill
      Objective: Run O1–O3 over every quarter in the historical range your partner confirms.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 4's manifests; Stage 5's full validation suite
      Produces: a complete filing-index table, submissions and extractions for the confirmed range
      Exit: O1 — every quarter in the range is in the table, and any gap is listed. O2 — every named submission is on disk or listed as failed. O3 — every 10-K and 8-K is extracted or listed as failed. The run's elapsed time and bytes are recorded.
      Leaves out: point-in-time awareness (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: writing-plans

- [ ] Stage 7: Point-in-time awareness
      Objective: Record later changes to quarterly indexes as changes, never as overwrites.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 6's complete filing-index table; Stage 4's manifests
      Produces: point-in-time awareness, with change records per quarter
      Exit: O1 — re-reading a changed quarterly index yields a recorded set of additions, updates and removals, and the prior state stays readable.
      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

      Objective: Ingest new daily indexes, and the submissions and filings they name, on a schedule in a deployed environment.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 4–7
      Produces: scheduling and deployment of the scheduled ingestion
      Exit: O1–O3 — scheduled runs on consecutive days ingest the new daily indexes and their submissions and filings, as shown by the run records. A missed day is caught up on the next run.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming
